overview: A romantic birthday surprise app with passcode unlock, personalized greeting, gift reveal flow (love letter, polaroid memories, reasons I love you), and playful animated interactions.
features: Passcode-protected unlock screen with couple photo and teddy
Happy birthday message page with custom photo upload
Readiness gate with funny rejection (angry teddy) if 'No' is pressed
Three selectable gift reveals: Love Letter, Polaroid Memories, Reasons I Love You
Final 'Hope you enjoyed it my love' ending after all gifts opened
All content (text, photos, dates) customizable by the creator via admin panel
